runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 39l and 48l, the latter here over 1m, in two starts last July; absent since and the step up in trip needs to bring about major improvement; best watched.

runners_data.name: Kenkelly
runners_data.note: Debutant from excellent staying pedigree with sister winning at 1m2f, Tom Clover stable running at decent strike rate

runners_data.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; tenth foal; sister to 1m2f/11.6f winner Handsome (RPR 83), half-sister to four winners including Ranch Hand (1m3f-2m including Listed; 109) and Victoria Pollard (1m2f; 88); dam 1m6f winner (101), half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Passing Glance; interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Clarissa Eclipse
runners_data.note: Well-bred newcomer with stamina influences in pedigree, Simcock excels with this type over middle distances
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to winners Colonia (US Grade 3) and Edestriav; market should guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners Colonia (8.5f/9.5f including US Grade 3; RPR 97) and Edestriav (French 11.5f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Don Bosco; market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Brilliant Star
runners_data.note: Front runner with class edge returning from 154-day break but Gosden stable in good form with strong debut record
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when runner-up over 1m at Newcastle on debut; should appreciate this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Showed signs of inexperience but shaped well when second of seven on her debut at Newcastle (1m, AW; 11-4) in November; switches to turf having been off since and should appreciate this step up in trip (out of an Irish Oaks winner); leading contender.

runners_data.name: Fanciulla Del West
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing steady progression, this trip should suit and Ashley Lewis retains the ride
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in both starts over 1m at Newcastle; pedigree suggests this trip will suit
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with encouragement on her debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in November and she built on that when third of seven over that same C&D next time; off since December but her pedigree suggests she'll be suited by this longer trip.

runners_data.name: Close To Me
runners_data.note: Fading finisher adding hood after poor Wolverhampton debut just 12 days ago, appears outclassed here
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two bumpers and on her Flat debut this month; hood now added
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers and it was the same story on her Flat debut at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) 12 days ago; hood now added.

races.paceDynamic: Brilliant Star is the only confirmed front runner and will set a manageable pace from the off, with Fanciulla Del West likely to sit prominent in second. The small field and lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than frantic, allowing the leaders to dictate terms through the middle sections. This sustainable gallop will suit prominent runners who can track the pace without stress, while hold-up horses like Millie's A Minx and Close To Me face the difficult task of making up ground in a slowly-run race. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front runners who can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Brilliant Star gets an easy lead and Robert Havlin can dictate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The Gosden filly will have every chance to show her debut promise with a perfect tactical setup. Her class edge over this restricted field becomes decisive when she's allowed to control the race from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Fanciulla Del West or one of the newcomers can sit handy and outkick Brilliant Star
scenarios.body: The pace-setter may pay for doing the donkey work as a fresher horse with tactical speed takes over in the final furlong. Ed Walker's filly showed promise on debut and this trip should suit her racing style perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If either Kenkelly or Clarissa Eclipse shows natural pace to sit prominent early
scenarios.body: The pedigrees suggest both debutants should handle this trip and the small field gives them room to manoeuvre. A well-bred newcomer from Simcock or Clover could have enough natural ability to capitalize on race fitness advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Millie's A Minx would need a miracle given her poor recent form but the trip extension might unlock improvement. Close To Me's recent poor form makes this scenario her only realistic chance of involvement.

watchPoints.text: Brilliant Star could get too easy a lead with Robert Havlin able to dictate completely uncontested fractions
Fanciulla Del West needs Ashley Lewis to overcome the 5lb claim and judge the pace perfectly from a tracking position
Kenkelly's debut performance will reveal if the staying pedigree translates to immediate racecourse ability
Close To Me's recent form suggests she may struggle to cope with this step up in class despite the hood addition
The pace scenario heavily favours the first two home being drawn from Brilliant Star and Fanciulla Del West

runners_data.spotlight: Seventh on his debut at Salisbury (1m, heavy) and twice on the AW (also over 1m) in novice events last year; gelded since last seen 141 days ago and now steps up in trip for his handicap debut; market should be informative.

runners_data.name: Heated Moment
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who showed early promise but regressed, needs to prove she retains ability after long break

runners_data.spotlight: Fifth in a Newbury (7f) maiden on her debut last August but she didn't progress from that in her next four starts (6f/7f), including two handicaps; has left Ollie Sangster since last seen and now steps up in trip for her yard debut having been bought for 4,000gns.

runners_data.name: Crimson Rambler
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong AW handicap wins this year, blinkers help his finishing kick
runners_data.comment: Has form figures of 2221142 in handicaps this year; should go well if seeing out the trip
runners_data.spotlight: Has form figures of 2221142 in handicaps this year since the blinkers went on, with the wins coming at Southwell (1m, AW) and Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW); has gone up 3lb for his recent runner-up effort at Nottingham but he should go well if seeing out this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Pantile's Gift looks the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners King Of Berkshire, Izz'nt She Hot and Kokushoku likely to sit just off the pace rather than challenge early. The moderate early gallop will mean the field stays compact through the middle stages at Yarmouth's tight track. With plenty of hold-up horses including Room Fourteen, Joyful Lawyer, Heated Moment and Crimson Rambler, this sets up perfectly for those racing from off the pace who can produce sustained finishing kicks in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and the field stays bunched approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get swamped by fresher finishers who've been biding their time in behind. Hold-up specialists with strong finishing kicks will have too much firepower for those who've been closer to a moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent prevails late
scenarios.trigger: If Pantile's Gift maintains control but the prominent horses get first run on the leaders
scenarios.body: Those positioned in the second rank can pick up the weakening pace-setter while staying ahead of the closing pack. The prominent runners benefit from racing handy without doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Pantile's Gift kicks clear approaching the final furlong and the hold-up horses are too far back
scenarios.body: The leader's recent Newcastle success gives him confidence over this trip and he can repel all challengers. Those racing from behind find themselves with too much ground to make up on the tight Yarmouth circuit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is exceptionally slow and turns into a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of acceleration rather than stamina, suiting those with the highest cruising speed. Horses with tactical speed rather than sustained galloping ability will thrive in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Pantile's Gift could get too easy a lead if the prominent horses are reluctant to race up with him early
Room Fourteen and Crimson Rambler both need the pace to develop properly to show their best finishing kicks
King Of Berkshire's stamina at 1m2f remains unproven after his York effort over 1m
Boilermaker's fitness after 141 days off despite being gelded makes him hard to assess
The good to firm ground may play against the hold-up horses if it prevents a strong early gallop

runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Chelmsford (6f) in December and not so bad as his recent form figures suggests, challenging wide when ninth in 6f Southwell handicap last month; this C&D winner is not out of things.

runners_data.name: Fenlander
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good recent form who should get ideal position tracking the leader

runners_data.spotlight: Remains winless but he resumed from four months off with a good second of nine in 6f Southwell handicap 16 days ago; in the mix nudged up 1lb.

runners_data.name: My Mate Kev
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner likely to get uncontested lead but form figures are concerning

runners_data.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Newmarket (6f) last May but well below that form subsequently, though not best drawn when 12th at Doncaster (5f) on his return; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: My Mate Kev will take them along from the front with no other natural leaders in this field, likely getting an easy time of it through moderate fractions. The prominent runners Dark Side Thunder, Ironist and Fenlander will track behind but may not apply serious pressure until late. Bill Plumb and Caragio as hold-up horses will depend on the pace quickening enough to bring them into play. This controlled tempo strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can travel easily and kick clear when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Kev gets soft fractions and isn't seriously challenged until the final furlong
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back despite modest recent form, while prominent runners like Fenlander and Ironist finish strongly but can't quite get there. The lack of pace pressure plays perfectly into the leader's hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners track My Mate Kev closely and apply sustained pressure from halfway
scenarios.body: Fenlander or Dark Side Thunder can wear down the leader and prove strongest in the final 100 yards with their superior recent form. The moderate pace still suits those who can sit handy and pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens more than expected in the second half and the race develops into a sprint
scenarios.body: Bill Plumb or Caragio can benefit from their patient tactics as the early leaders come back to them. Both showed improved form last time and this tactical switch could pay dividends.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ironist Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Ironist handles her long absence and the prominent group goes fast enough to set up her finishing kick
scenarios.body: Her previous course form and consistent profile make her dangerous despite the layoff. The race needs to be run at a decent gallop for her hold-up style to be effective.

watchPoints.text: My Mate Kev could steal this if allowed to bowl along unchallenged and dictate the entire race
Bill Plumb and Caragio need the pace to quicken significantly to bring their hold-up tactics into play
Ironist's 190-day absence is a concern but her previous course form suggests she could be ready
Dark Side Thunder's wide challenge at Southwell suggests he may need luck in running here
Fenlander's recent second shows he's in good heart and the trip reduction could suit

runners_data.spotlight: Stepped forward from his first two efforts when fourth of nine at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in October; subsequently gelded but he pulled too hard on handicap debut at Newcastle (7f, AW; hooded) 61 days ago; drops back in trip with the hood removed.

races.paceDynamic: Ocean Of Storms will lead from the gate with no other confirmed front runners to challenge him early. The Crisford-trained gelding can dictate terms through moderate fractions while Argy Bhaji, Eyes Front and Wild Rosie settle prominently behind. With Ocean Of Storms able to control the tempo without pressure, the pace is likely to be steady early before quickening from the 2f pole. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the leader closely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean Of Storms gets an easy lead and sustains his kick
scenarios.body: Ocean Of Storms sets sustainable fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, benefiting from his tactical advantage. The hold-up horses face too much ground to make up in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Argy Bhaji or Eyes Front press Ocean Of Storms from 2f out
scenarios.body: The prominent runners use their position to challenge the leader in the straight while hold-up horses are caught flat-footed. Argy Bhaji's recent second gives him the form edge to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Flourish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with prominent horses pressing
scenarios.body: Space Bear and Eightthreeone benefit from a fast pace that sets up their closing kicks. The early speed duel compromises the leaders' finishing efforts over this sharp 6f trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean Of Storms goes too slow and everyone finishes in a bunch
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker with all horses having a chance in a blanket finish. Fresh legs and tactical speed become more important than early position.

watchPoints.text: Ocean Of Storms could get too easy a lead if prominent horses don't press him early enough
Eyes Front may struggle to build on his maiden form after disappointing in three handicaps
Wild Rosie's fitness after 175 days off could be a factor despite working well at home
Space Bear and other hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace
Eightthreeone's recent winner needs the pace to develop favorably for his closing kick to be effective

races.paceDynamic: Shimmering Spin is the sole confirmed front runner in this 12-runner field and should get an uncontested lead with Dashing Dick and Captain Parma the only prominent racers likely to track him early. The lack of pace pressure means Shimmering Spin can dictate comfortable fractions over 7f, setting up a tactical affair rather than a true test of stamina. With 9 hold-up horses in the field including proven finishers like Grabajabba, Mister Mojito and Gorgeous Mr George, this race shape strongly favours patient hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot in the final 2f when the pace steadies.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Shimmering Spin gets soft fractions and kicks clear 2f out without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to conserve energy and prove hard to peg back despite moderate ability. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground when the pace hasn't been strong enough to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early pace suits the patient runners who can quicken best in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Grabajabba and Mister Mojito benefit from their proven course form and finishing kicks when racing unfolds tactically. The abundance of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge finish that favours the classiest finishers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Dick or Captain Parma track the leader perfectly and kick when Shimmering Spin weakens
scenarios.body: The patient prominent racers get the best of both worlds - avoiding the early lead but staying close enough to strike. They benefit from racing handy without doing too much work in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Suits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the slow pace and large field creates traffic problems and scrimmaging in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace bunches the field and creates interference that catches out the fancied runners. An unfancied runner with a good draw or rail position like Rogue Allegiance can nick it.

races.paceDynamic: Very Demure is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an easy lead with no early pressure. The rest are predominantly hold-up horses who will settle behind and rely on late kicks. With such a small field and minimal pace pressure, Very Demure can dictate terms and potentially steal a march on the closers. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure gets soft fractions and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal splits and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising their challenges. The lack of pace pressure allows her to save enough for the finish despite her recent poor form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and turns into a sprint
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a tactical affair that becomes a dash from the furlong pole. Superior class horses can unleash their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure goes too slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: It becomes a messy scramble where positioning and luck in running matter more than ability. Those drawn well and getting clear runs benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Folds
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure stops quickly after setting the pace
scenarios.body: Her collapse creates gaps and opportunities for those tracking closest behind to inherit the lead. Mid-division runners with tactical pace can capitalise.
